title: Revisiting the Marcus inverted regime: modulation strategies for photogenerated ultrafast carrier transfer from semiconducting quantum dots to metal oxides
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,26897-26918
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04311E, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zhexu Xi
This review bridges theory, simulations, and spectroscopy to reveal why the Marcus inverted region is elusive at quantum-dot/metal-oxide interfaces, highlighting strategies to control charge transfer for advanced solar and optoelectronic devices.
